title: Mastodon Pocket
summary: A Mastodon client for Cardputer Zero with phone QR sign-in for easy access.
description:
Read your Mastodon home and local feeds, scroll through posts, and write public posts from your Cardputer Zero.

Sign in by scanning a QR code with your phone and approving access. Sign-in completes automatically without typing an authorization code. (Manual access-token login is also available)

Includes light and dark purple themes, adjustable text size, keyboard controls, and saved settings. Requires Wi-Fi and a Mastodon account.

Beta release: automated checks have passed, but testing on a physical Cardputer Zero is still pending. Media appears as attachment markers, and accounts must sign in again after closing the app.
